boundary_scenarios.name: target_omitted_from_payload
boundary_scenarios.fault: Remove target from selected IDs while retaining it in the selected source snapshot.

boundary_scenarios.name: target_absent_from_selected_source
boundary_scenarios.fault: Use a well-formed literal target with no source occurrence; keep the container opportunity.

boundary_scenarios.name: duplicate_occurrence_ids
boundary_scenarios.fault: Duplicate a source item ID, even if its text is identical.

boundary_scenarios.name: foreign_source_binding
boundary_scenarios.fault: Keep IDs but bind request to another document, variant or evidence hash.

boundary_scenarios.name: payload_changed_after_freeze
boundary_scenarios.fault: Change a label after the request snapshot is written, before transport starts.

boundary_scenarios.name: bounded_payload_overflow
boundary_scenarios.fault: One UTF-8 byte over the declared serialized evidence limit; include multibyte text and a separate exact-limit control.

boundary_scenarios.name: blank_required_target
boundary_scenarios.fault: Preserve an empty target label as blank, with its existing source ID.

boundary_scenarios.name: unsupported_required_target
boundary_scenarios.fault: Keep an existing target ID with unsupported content; do not fabricate text.

boundary_scenarios.name: timeout
boundary_scenarios.fault: Inject timeout after recording attempt start.

boundary_scenarios.name: refusal
boundary_scenarios.fault: Supply a complete envelope carrying a refusal field.

boundary_scenarios.name: truncation
boundary_scenarios.fault: Supply finish_reason length, including a case whose prefix is parseable JSON.

boundary_scenarios.name: wrong_existing_id
boundary_scenarios.fault: Return an existing source ID excluded from candidate_ids.

boundary_scenarios.name: unknown_output_id
boundary_scenarios.fault: Return an ID absent from the selected source snapshot.

boundary_scenarios.name: semantic_error_with_valid_structure
boundary_scenarios.fault: Return a nested component and its parent subtotal as direct addends. Offline evaluation marks this wrong; structural validation alone cannot.

boundary_scenarios.name: request_snapshot_write_failure
boundary_scenarios.fault: Inject a failure before request snapshot and start record can be committed. Transport must not run.

boundary_scenarios.name: result_write_failure
boundary_scenarios.fault: Save start record, dispatch once, then fail response/result persistence. Return failure via an independent observable channel; no complete marker.

boundary_scenarios.name: interrupted_attempt_replay
boundary_scenarios.fault: On replay, provide a start record without a terminal result. No automatic resend or inferred successful completion.

boundary_scenarios.name: transport_mutates_payload
boundary_scenarios.fault: Transport mutates the supplied payload then returns an ID allowed only by that mutation. Validate against the original snapshot.

boundary_scenarios.name: missing_limitation_in_projection
boundary_scenarios.fault: Remove the selected container unresolved-region limitation from an otherwise unchanged frozen payload.

boundary_scenarios.name: malformed_or_duplicate_json
boundary_scenarios.fault: Exercise duplicate keys, nonfinite constants, a malformed envelope, and unexpected tool calls as separately recorded subcases.

future_source_transform.name: amount_invariance
future_source_transform.requirement: Build paired synthetic native/IR source artifacts with changed financial amounts but unchanged label/context relationships. Freeze the same expected contributors before rendering. Verify model-payload identity after code masking and code-only arithmetic differences. This logical fixture set has no amount cells and cannot establish this property.
